narrative.intro: Frequentis Usa obligated $298M in FY2026 to date. Frequentis Usa received 9 awards in the period, with an average award size of $33.1M. Obligations were up 90.8% year over year. Annual obligations show a clear rise: FY21 $8.4M, FY22 $7.6M, FY23 $7.2M, FY24 $34.3M, FY25 $156M, FY26 $298M. Market concentration is high: Telephone Apparatus Manufacturing accounted for $283M of obligations in FY2026 to date. Several smaller markets also appear, including Search, Detection, Navigation, Guidance, Aeronautical, and Nautical System and Instrument Manufacturing at $9.6M, and Radio and Television Broadcasting and Wireless Communications Equipment Manufacturing at $3.9M. Engineering Services, Computer Systems Design Services, and Communication Equipment Repair and Maintenance registered $662K, $100K, and $55.2K respectively. This profile shows most federal obligations for Frequentis Usa in FY2026 to date are centered in a single NAICS market while a few adjacent markets account for the remainder of recorded obligations.
